newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares firm, pushed up by Droga.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares firm, pushed up by Droga.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 0.74 on Friday, pushed up by a ten percent jump in food maker Droga after the company said on Thursday 1996 net profit had risen 30 percent.

"Droga was by far the main player today. But I think the market's overall lull will continue until foreign investors definitively return to our market," said Andrej Potocnik, a trader at brokerage BPH.
* The SBI index rose 10.06 points to 1,377.7.
* Overall three shares rose, eight fell and four were unchanged, while 11 were untraded.
* Droga was the day's biggest gainer, jumping 10 percent to 26,400 tolars on volume of 611 shares.
